test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

People think the government will change the economic policies

options.text: The government has been thinking to change the economic policies.
The government will think to change the economic policies.
It is thought that the economic policies will be changed by the government.
People thought that the government will change the economic policies.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "People think the government will change the economic policies."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the economic policies" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will change" to "will be changed" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the government."
 
• Ensure the introductory phrase "It is thought that" is added for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It is thought that the economic policies will be changed by the government."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The government has been thinking to change the economic policies." – This is not in passive voice.
 
• **Option 2: **"The government will think to change the economic policies." – This is not in passive voice.
 
• **Option 4: **"People thought that the government will change the economic policies." – This is not in passive voice.
